We’re excited to announce that CSV export is now live! Starting Tuesday, 12 November, you can export any report directly from our platform.

Navigate to **Reports → Export** to download your data in CSV format. The export will include all columns currently visible in your report view.

This feature is available across all plans, making it easier than ever to analyze and share your data outside of the dashboard.

Happy exporting!
